name: Grid Traversal Setup (DDA)
definition: Initializes parameters for a 3D Digital Differential Analyzer (DDA) to traverse a voxel grid along a ray, computing step directions, initial indices, and distances to voxel boundaries.
summary: Grid Traversal Setup initializes 3D DDA parameters for voxel grids by mapping ray origins to indices and boundary distances, differing from computational space traversal by operating directly in uniform grid coordinates.
